children: Global Health Care AG restated option B to sell 60% of milon Holding GmbH on a €23.3M equity value; 40% would remain with the company. The 14 December 2026 meeting will vote on option B only if option A is not adopted.
Option B sells 60% at €23.3M equity value
Sets the proposed valuation for a majority stake sale; the transaction remains contingent on the meeting's vote and option A not passing.
Company expects €0.8M cash and ~€4.1M lower liabilities
Provides near-term liquidity and reduces liabilities, though most stated consideration is non-cash.
Up to 6% more may be sold by 31 Dec 2027
Potential proceeds of at least ~€1.4M could support repayment of the 2024/2029 bond; the sale is not guaranteed.
Removes the previously announced alternative consideration from option B, changing the proposed transaction structure.

This is a revised transaction proposal ahead of the extraordinary General Meeting, not a completed sale. Investors will need the 14 December vote outcome and subsequent execution of the stake transfers and any additional share sale.
from Global Health Care AG distributed by EQS.
